numerical_investigation.status: Audit findings and proposed contracts only
numerical_investigation.representation: Propose four top-to-bottom dot counts, each 1 or 2. Odd maps to 1, even to 2. Bit representation, if used, must declare 1=single and 0=double; integer bit order cannot be implicit.
numerical_investigation.algebra: Per-line parity addition: 1+1 -> 2; 1+2 -> 1; 2+1 -> 1; 2+2 -> 2. XOR applies to parity bits, not directly to displayed dot counts.
numerical_investigation.source_locator: Turner paragraphs Of these foure Matres, And these 8 Figures, After the same manner
numerical_investigation.construction: Mothers 1–4; Daughter j takes row j of each Mother in Mother order. Positions 9–12 combine (1,2),(3,4),(5,6),(7,8). Witnesses combine (9,10),(11,12); Judge combines (13,14).
numerical_investigation.optional_sixteenth: Bennett documents super-judge = position 1 plus position 15; not attested here as mandatory Turner procedure or verified Greer reconciler.
numerical_investigation.display: Bennett Mothers run right-to-left; preserve logical position separately from screen direction. Turner common house paragraph says left-to-right. Never silently substitute one placement.
numerical_investigation.invariants: Editorial mathematical checks proposed: sixteen possible patterns, 16^4=65536 Mother tuples, transposition involution, commutativity/associativity, self-addition gives all doubles, Judge total-point parity even. These are construction checks, not divinatory validation.
numerical_investigation.figure_identity_gate: Turner table hcafig1 visually inspected. Names: Fortuna major, Fortuna minor, Via, Populus, Acquisitio, Laetitia, Puella, Amissio, Conjunctio, Albus, Puer, Rubeus, Carcer, Tristitia, dragon head, dragon tail. Normalize spellings only with aliases/provenance. Full sixteen-pattern catalog withheld until independent source pass.

proposed_core.priority: Manual complete sixteen-figure identities and four-Mother shield derivation with source-linked dependency trace; narrow factual name/alias or lexical gloss only where verified.
proposed_core.manual_inputs: Exactly four ordered four-line Mothers or sixteen explicitly ordered positive mark counts; distinguish entered counts from entered parity. Reject booleans, mixed modes, missing rows and unknown figure IDs.
proposed_core.seeded: Optional after manual core: sixteen independent parity choices WITH replacement. Do not use four cards without replacement or shuffle a 16-figure deck: repeated Mothers must remain possible.
proposed_core.reuse: Existing future/card_random.py has frozen SHA256 stream, explicit UTF8 seed and rejection sampling but only deck/orientation domains. Reuse design/helpers only under a separately versioned geomancy domain/protocol with known-answer vectors; do not alter inherited prefixes, domains or seed outputs. No protocol implemented in audit.
proposed_core.report: Offline JSON/Markdown: source/profile version/hash, explicit convention, raw question/input/origin, logical positions, figures, parents and parity trace, optional-sixteenth flag, unsupported judgment boundaries and complete replay.
proposed_core.interpretation: Direct sourced names/rules; compositional arithmetic labelled editorial; personal association stays user-attributed; unknown/unverified judgments explicit.
